title: Write the shooter's states
summary: Write handleStateTransition and the switch in updateLogic.

steps.title: Open ShooterSubsystem.java
steps.say: Two TODOs live in the shooter subsystem. Press **Ctrl+P**, type `ShooterSubsystem` and press Enter. Quick Open finds any file by name, so you never have to dig through folders.

steps.title: Find it
steps.say: First the rules for moving between states. Press **Ctrl+F**, type `write the transitions` and press Enter to jump to it.

waitFor.hint: find write the transitions with Ctrl+F.

steps.title: Transitions
steps.say: Turn the comment above it into code: from IDLE, wanting SHOOT goes to SPIN_UP; from SPIN_UP go to SHOOT once `flywheel.isAtSpeed()`; from SHOOT go back to SPIN_UP if `flywheel.hasDipped()`; anything else, IDLE.

steps.title: Find it
steps.say: Then what each state does. Press **Ctrl+F**, type `write a switch (system_state_)` and press Enter to jump to it.

waitFor.hint: find write a switch (system_state_) with Ctrl+F.

steps.title: The switch
steps.say: One `case` per state, with the three lines the comment lists. IDLE stops both motors, SPIN_UP calls `runFlywheel()`, SHOOT also runs the roller at `CONSTANTS.INDEX_DUTY_CYCLE`.
